ebitda_margin.rationale: No EBITDA disclosed in the teaser; assumed 28% margin from comparable rigid-packaging peers (~29-30%).

da_pct.rationale: No D&A line; assumed 6% of revenue given the capital-intensive plant base.

interest_rate.rationale: No interest disclosed; assumed 7.5% cost of debt on the €70-80m balance (senior + mezz blended).

capex_pct.rationale: No capex disclosed; assumed 5% of revenue (maintenance-led).

maint_split.rationale: Assumed 70% maintenance for a steady-state plant network.
